names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 decembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Porfirie Kavsokalivitul», with the rank words left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Πορφύριος ο Καυσοκαλυβίτης ο διορατικός και θαυματουργός», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a născut pe 7 februarie 1906 în satul Sfântul Ioan din Karistia, Evia.»

death.note: doxologia.ro quotes the cross on his grave: «Ieromonah Porfirie. Adormit în Domnul pe 19 noiembrie 1991».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 decembrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Porfirie Kavsokalivitul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Όσιος Πορφύριος ο Καυσοκαλυβίτης ο διορατικός και θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it is the same man the folder already keeps from doxologia.ro with the years 1906 and 1991. Its page is very long and this reader took only the day and the line; none of its prose was used, and its six Ἀπολυτίκια and four Κοντάκια were not read and are not drafted. They are named here so the next reader knows they are there.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: După cum pe pământ te rugai pentru tămăduirea neputinţelor şi pentru iertarea păcatelor noastre, tot astfel şi acum roagă-te în ceruri, părinte Porfirie, şi roagă-L pe Hristos Dumnezeul nostru să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

english.text: As on earth you prayed for the healing of our infirmities and for the forgiveness of our sins, so now also pray in heaven, father Porphyrios, and entreat Christ our God to save our souls.
